2026-10-21_1951.text: Use character names, not player names: Goose is Thia (she/her), Justin is Llyr. The "terrible at practicing law" line was said by the DM, not Sykth, and it's notable because the DM actually practises law. In the loose threads, the five-headed screamer in the chasm IS the teen: keep that the boy rose as the teen and then grew five heads. The DM said he would NOT make Thia wait until morning for the spell slot: by the same rule as HP reduction, it's applied immediately.
